product_metadata.title: RFAQK 100pcs Cake Pan Set for Baking + Cake Decorating Supplies: 3 Round Non Stick Springform Pan Set (4, 7, 9 inches), Icing Tips, Cake Leveler – Multi-functional Leak-Proof Cheese Cake Pans & eBook
features: ✅ Everything You Need to Bake Cheesecakes & Layer/Tier Cakes: RFAQK brings everything you need for baking and decorating your favorite types of cakes. Here’s what this package includes: ✔ 8-inch cake pan ✔ 7-inch cake pan ✔ 4-inch mini cake Pan ✔ 30 Pcs Parchment Paper Liners ✔ 1 Cake Leveler ✔ 7 Icing Tips ✔ 2 Piping Bag Couplers ✔ 1 Icing Spatula ✔ 3 Scrappers ✔ 15 Disposable Piping Bags ✔ 40 Disposable Cupcake Liners.

✅ Ultimate Springform Set for Multipurpose Baking: This cake pan set for baking includes 3 Springform Pans of different sizes, a mini cake pan (4 inches), a small cake pan (7 inches), and a large cake pan (8 inches). All this gives you the freedom to bake cheesecakes, pizzas, quiches, ice-cream cakes, lasagnas, and much more.

✅ Easy to Use; Non-Stick & Leak-proof: Even if you’re a beginner or pro your struggle with cake pans leaking or sticking is very common. RFAQK solves it effortlessly with premium quality springform pans, which stay non-stick and leak-proof over time.

✅ Range of Premium Cake Decorating Kit: Once baked, cake decorating is the next important step in your cake-mastering journey. This 100pcs set apart from cake pans includes a large variety of essential cake decorating tools such as Icing Tips, Scrappers, Cake Levelers, Spatulas and Couplers.

✅ Love from One Baker to Another: All the cake pans and tools included are BPA-free and tried-and-tested under different environments – as a baker ourselves we have done it all to assure your 100% satisfaction. The eBook along is designed to help you get the maximum out of this set. Still, if there is something, feel free to contact us; we are available 24/7.
